readerCopy.body: A larger opportunity can become a distraction if it lets you avoid the smaller decision that would actually change your direction. When Jupiter squares the North Node, another project, promise, credential, trip, or ambitious plan can feel like progress while the unresolved choice underneath it keeps returning. More options do not help much when every option preserves the same indecision. Cut the plan back to the decision that changes what you actually do next, then let expansion follow the choice instead of replacing it.
